http_contract: GET /api/tickets?status=all|open|closed; POST /api/tickets {title}; POST /api/tickets/{id}/close; GET /health. app.create_server(host,port,data_path) returns a stoppable HTTPServer.
ui_contract: form#ticket-form input[name=title], select#status-filter values all/open/closed, rows [data-ticket-id], close button [data-action=close]. Keyboard labels, visible focus, useful empty/error feedback.
